name: Colossus droid
description: Colossus droid was a type of droid designed on Iokath after the species that created the world went extinct following the Iokath Civil War. The only remaining self-aware droid on Iokath ARIES used other droids as his slaves, weaponizing them into combat units regardless of their original purpose. The Colossus droid was developed as a massive war machine dozens of meters tall and capable of wiping out an entire army.
